verdicts.reason: Both use the same scattered three-column layout. 'Every mixed case.' sits in a top row far from the '20% off' headline it belongs to, the eye reads the subhead and CTA before the headline, and 'Ends Sunday' floats alone in the right column with a lot of dead space around it. A keeps a left margin, though its circle is cut off at the bottom. B pushes the circle hard against the left edge, cutting it off on both the left and the bottom, and '20% off' and 'WEEKEND ONLY' sit almost on the canvas edge, so B looks more cramped.
